status: predeclared before any G4 run (Nov 17, 2026); separate from protocol step6-v2 (current_v1, physical_v1), which is unchanged; do not edit after G4 results exist
decision: D7 (docs/step6_v2_decisions.md): G4 is a diagnostic unconstrained upper bound, not a controlled comparison of constraints
interpretation: G4 asks only whether LIME (and TreeSHAP) on these models can be moved beyond seed noise AT ALL with large edits. A G4 success is never evidence of a physically realizable network attack: G4 edits derived and dependent features independently, without repair, and its candidates are labelled by the physical report

policy.name: unconstrained_g4_v1
policy.frozen_reason: categorical (proto, service, state), attack-required (is_ftp_login, ct_ftp_cmd, ct_flw_http_mthd) and non-controllable (is_sm_ips_ports) in src/unsw/constraints.py
policy.random_step: uniform(0, 0.5] per selected feature, random sign
policy.rounding: features in src.unsw.constraints.INTEGER_FEATURES are rounded to integers
policy.range: clamped to the observed official-training range (src.unsw.constraints.NUMERIC_MIN_MAX)
policy.derived_features: edited like any other feature; NOT recomputed
policy.must_stay_attack: P(attack) >= 0.5 for the model being attacked

shuffled_greedy.description: first-improvement coordinate search scored against the original explanation; feature and direction order shuffled with numpy default_rng([order_seed, sample, sum(ord(model))])

random_control.description: best-of-N random proposals (1-10 features) with the same features, budget, objective, LIME seed and LIME budget; numpy default_rng([control_seed, sample, sum(ord(model)), 4])

success_criteria.lime_diagnostic: D8 combined held-out test without the physical condition: still attack AND within the G4 policy AND held-out top-10 Jaccard AND Spearman both below the original's held-out seed-pair minimum; reported as DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; confirmed on seeds 401-404 as in D14
success_criteria.shap_diagnostic: D11 measures (top-10 Jaccard and tie-aware Spearman of TreeSHAP vs the SHAP-vs-LIME reference) on the same checkpoint candidates; reported as DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
success_criteria.physical: every candidate gets physical_report_v2; consistent_with_checked_rules, unverified_dependencies and violates_checked_rule candidates are counted separately and never called physically valid

full_run.note: 10 flows x 2 models x (10 shuffled + 10 random) x 100 calls; not started without approval
